sentence: Runs a single-elimination bracket of eight movies where chat members vote on each match and the leading side advances until one movie wins the final.
use_when: a group needs to pick one movie to watch from a short list
people want head-to-head votes instead of one big poll
a movie night needs a fun way to settle on a film
a list of eight options needs narrowing to one winner
dont_use_when: a simple one-question yes/no or multiple choice poll is enough
the options are not movies or not a list of eight
a person needs to schedule a time or split a bill
